editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: MultiBank Group is a legitimate, multi-regulated broker with 20 years of operation and institutional-grade financial backing — $322 million in paid-up capital and 14+ regulatory licences including ASIC, BaFin, CySEC, and MAS. The ECN account at $6 round-turn commission from 0.0 pips is genuinely competitive pricing in 2026, and Lloyd's of London insurance up to $1,000,000 per customer through the MEX Atlantic entity is rare protection at the retail level. But the consumer feedback tells a different story to the credentials: SiteJabber rates MultiBank 2.1 out of 5, Trustpilot presence is limited, and the gap between editorial praise and actual user experience is the widest we have encountered in this review queue. The Japan FSA warning and the ASIC clone warning against 'JP MultiBank Group' add regulatory noise that a broker of this calibre should not be attracting. The $10,000 ECN minimum locks out most retail traders from the best pricing. For professionals with significant capital who value regulatory breadth and institutional backing above crowd-sourced proof of withdrawal reliability, MultiBank is a serious contender. For everyone else, brokers with 50,000+ positive Trustpilot reviews offer something MultiBank cannot yet demonstrate — mass-verified trust.
